note: Laundry alley as connected rooms with story roles. 'sequence' rooms run left to right; 'above' rooms sit on top of a sequence room (reached through a gap in its floor); 'below' rooms sit under a room and are reached by an in-location descent (stairs, breach, drop, hatch) named by a portal's targetRole. Room ids follow the listed order. The old laundry_house, catchment_cellar and catchment_vault location folders are no longer linked from the game; their content now lives in templates 7, 8 and 9.
